{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017R64PPZ7YG5t77HhEgx9gu","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t// Package cli parses ddkstat arguments and orchestrates a single run.\n2\tpackage cli\n3\t\n4\timport (\n5\t\t\"flag\"\n6\t\t\"fmt\"\n7\t\t\"io\"\n8\t)\n9\t\n10\tconst usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\"\n11\t\n12\t// Exit codes, as declared in the architecture.\n13\tconst (\n14\t\texitRead  = 1\n15\t\texitUsage = 2\n16\t)\n17\t\n18\t// reportNames lists the six reports in the order the architecture declares them.\n19\tvar reportNames = []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"}\n20\t\n21\t// Options is the parsed ddkstat command line.\n22\ttype Options struct {\n23\t\tReport    string\n24\t\tTarget    string\n25\t\tHasTarget bool\n26\t\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n27\t\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n28\t\tLog       string\n29\t}\n30\t\n31\t// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n32\t// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. Date values\n33\t// are not validated here.\n34\tfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n35\t\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n36\t\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n37\t\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n38\t\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n39\t\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n40\t\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n41\t\tif err != nil {\n42\t\t\treturn Options{}, err\n43\t\t}\n44\t\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n45\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n46\t\t}\n47\t\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n48\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n49\t\t}\n50\t\topts := Options{\n51\t\t\tReport: positional[0],\n52\t\t\tTarget: *target,\n53\t\t\tSince:  *since,\n54\t\t\tUntil:  *until,\n55\t\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n56\t\t}\n57\t\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n58\t\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n59\t\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n60\t\t\t}\n61\t\t})\n62\t\treturn opts, nil\n63\t}\n64\t\n65\t// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\n66\tfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n67\t\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n68\t\t\tif r == name {\n69\t\t\t\treturn true\n70\t\t\t}\n71\t\t}\n72\t\treturn false\n73\t}\n74\t\n75\t// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n76\t// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\n77\tfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n78\t\topts, err := Parse(args)\n79\t\tif err != nil {\n80\t\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n81\t\t\treturn exitUsage\n82\t\t}\n83\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n84\t\treturn exitRead\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\t// parseInterspersed parses flags that may appear before, between, or after positional\n88\t// arguments, as the flag package alone stops at the first positional. A bare \"--\" ends\n89\t// option parsing, and everything after it is positional.\n90\tfunc parseInterspersed(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) ([]string, error) {\n91\t\tvar positional []string\n92\t\tfor {\n93\t\t\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n94\t\t\t\treturn nil, err\n95\t\t\t}\n96\t\t\trest := fs.Args()\n97\t\t\tif consumed := len(args) - len(rest); consumed > 0 && args[consumed-1] == \"--\" {\n98\t\t\t\treturn append(positional, rest...), nil\n99\t\t\t}\n100\t\t\tif len(rest) == 0 {\n101\t\t\t\treturn positional, nil\n102\t\t\t}\n103\t\t\tpositional = append(positional, rest[0])\n104\t\t\targs = rest[1:]\n105\t\t}\n106\t}\n107\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"c1c93631-3c04-4fb1-885e-f67834fd3019","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:43:45.086Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/cli/cli.go","content":"// Package cli parses ddkstat arguments and orchestrates a single run.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\nconst usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\"\n\n// Exit codes, as declared in the architecture.\nconst (\n\texitRead  = 1\n\texitUsage = 2\n)\n\n// reportNames lists the six reports in the order the architecture declares them.\nvar reportNames = []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"}\n\n// Options is the parsed ddkstat command line.\ntype Options struct {\n\tReport    string\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tLog       string\n}\n\n// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. Date values\n// are not validated here.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport: positional[0],\n\t\tTarget: *target,\n\t\tSince:  *since,\n\t\tUntil:  *until,\n\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n\t}\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}\n\n// parseInterspersed parses flags that may appear before, between, or after positional\n// arguments, as the flag package alone stops at the first positional. A bare \"--\" ends\n// option parsing, and everything after it is positional.\nfunc parseInterspersed(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) ([]string, error) {\n\tvar positional []string\n\tfor {\n\t\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\trest := fs.Args()\n\t\tif consumed := len(args) - len(rest); consumed > 0 && args[consumed-1] == \"--\" {\n\t\t\treturn append(positional, rest...), nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(rest) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn positional, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tpositional = append(positional, rest[0])\n\t\targs = rest[1:]\n\t}\n}\n","numLines":107,"startLine":1,"totalLines":107}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_017R64PPZ7YG5t77HhEgx9gu","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"f4d6c999-d611-4237-88a1-41fd212cfb28","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:43:47.683Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/cli/cli.go","oldString":"import (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)","newString":"import (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)","originalFile":"// Package cli parses ddkstat arguments and orchestrates a single run.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\nconst usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\"\n\n// Exit codes, as declared in the architecture.\nconst (\n\texitRead  = 1\n\texitUsage = 2\n)\n\n// reportNames lists the six reports in the order the architecture declares them.\nvar reportNames = []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"}\n\n// Options is the parsed ddkstat command line.\ntype Options struct {\n\tReport    string\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tLog       string\n}\n\n// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. Date values\n// are not validated here.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport: positional[0],\n\t\tTarget: *target,\n\t\tSince:  *since,\n\t\tUntil:  *until,\n\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n\t}\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}\n\n// parseInterspersed parses flags that may appear before, between, or after positional\n// arguments, as the flag package alone stops at the first positional. A bare \"--\" ends\n// option parsing, and everything after it is positional.\nfunc parseInterspersed(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) ([]string, error) {\n\tvar positional []string\n\tfor {\n\t\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\trest := fs.Args()\n\t\tif consumed := len(args) - len(rest); consumed > 0 && args[consumed-1] == \"--\" {\n\t\t\treturn append(positional, rest...), nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(rest) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn positional, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tpositional = append(positional, rest[0])\n\t\targs = rest[1:]\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":6,"newStart":5,"newLines":10,"lines":["   \"flag\"","   \"fmt\"","   \"io\"","+  \"os\"","+  \"time\"","+","+  \"ddkstat/internal/logread\""," )"," "," const usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01UaGN8JwF5gfpJ7Urhc4tvA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. Date values\n// are not validated here.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport: positional[0],\n\t\tTarget: *target,\n\t\tSince:  *since,\n\t\tUntil:  *until,\n\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n\t}\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}","new_string":"// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. A given\n// --since or --until must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date, or Parse returns an error.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\tset := make(map[string]bool)\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tset[f.Name] = true\n\t})\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport:    positional[0],\n\t\tTarget:    *target,\n\t\tHasTarget: set[\"target\"],\n\t\tLog:       positional[1],\n\t}\n\tif set[\"since\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Since, err = validateDate(*since); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--since: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif set[\"until\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Until, err = validateDate(*until); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--until: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// dateLayout is the only accepted form of --since and --until: a real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// validateDate returns value unchanged when it is exactly ten characters and a real calendar\n// date in the YYYY-MM-DD layout, so leap days are honored. It never normalizes a value.\nfunc validateDate(value string) (string, error) {\n\tif len(value) != len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a YYYY-MM-DD date\", value)\n\t}\n\tif _, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a real calendar date\", value)\n\t}\n\treturn value, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\treturn execute(opts, stdout, stderr, func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error) {\n\t\treturn logread.ReadFile(opts.Log, warn)\n\t})\n}\n\n// execute reads the log through load and returns the exit code. A log that cannot be read exits\n// 1 with one diagnostic on stderr. Report output will go to stdout only after the whole log has\n// been read, so a failing read never leaves partial output.\nfunc execute(opts Options, stdout, stderr io.Writer, load func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error)) int {\n\tif _, err := load(stderr); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: cannot read log: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitRead\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":21098,"cache_read_input_tokens":52349,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":21098},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"491fc6ab-069e-4b9c-bdb1-00ac4468ba20","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:43:53.666Z","request_id":"req_011CgQ11kNtPnHdJpRYFEjej","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01K6RQUckKLx7ozPbDNTUd4P":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/cli/cli.go","old_string":"// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. Date values\n// are not validated here.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport: positional[0],\n\t\tTarget: *target,\n\t\tSince:  *since,\n\t\tUntil:  *until,\n\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n\t}\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}","newString":"// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. A given\n// --since or --until must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date, or Parse returns an error.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\tset := make(map[string]bool)\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tset[f.Name] = true\n\t})\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport:    positional[0],\n\t\tTarget:    *target,\n\t\tHasTarget: set[\"target\"],\n\t\tLog:       positional[1],\n\t}\n\tif set[\"since\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Since, err = validateDate(*since); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--since: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif set[\"until\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Until, err = validateDate(*until); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--until: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// dateLayout is the only accepted form of --since and --until: a real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// validateDate returns value unchanged when it is exactly ten characters and a real calendar\n// date in the YYYY-MM-DD layout, so leap days are honored. It never normalizes a value.\nfunc validateDate(value string) (string, error) {\n\tif len(value) != len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a YYYY-MM-DD date\", value)\n\t}\n\tif _, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a real calendar date\", value)\n\t}\n\treturn value, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\treturn execute(opts, stdout, stderr, func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error) {\n\t\treturn logread.ReadFile(opts.Log, warn)\n\t})\n}\n\n// execute reads the log through load and returns the exit code. A log that cannot be read exits\n// 1 with one diagnostic on stderr. Report output will go to stdout only after the whole log has\n// been read, so a failing read never leaves partial output.\nfunc execute(opts Options, stdout, stderr io.Writer, load func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error)) int {\n\tif _, err := load(stderr); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: cannot read log: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitRead\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}","originalFile":"// Package cli parses ddkstat arguments and orchestrates a single run.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\nconst usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\"\n\n// Exit codes, as declared in the architecture.\nconst (\n\texitRead  = 1\n\texitUsage = 2\n)\n\n// reportNames lists the six reports in the order the architecture declares them.\nvar reportNames = []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"}\n\n// Options is the parsed ddkstat command line.\ntype Options struct {\n\tReport    string\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tLog       string\n}\n\n// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. Date values\n// are not validated here.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport: positional[0],\n\t\tTarget: *target,\n\t\tSince:  *since,\n\t\tUntil:  *until,\n\t\tLog:    positional[1],\n\t}\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tif f.Name == \"target\" {\n\t\t\topts.HasTarget = true\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}\n\n// parseInterspersed parses flags that may appear before, between, or after positional\n// arguments, as the flag package alone stops at the first positional. A bare \"--\" ends\n// option parsing, and everything after it is positional.\nfunc parseInterspersed(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) ([]string, error) {\n\tvar positional []string\n\tfor {\n\t\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\trest := fs.Args()\n\t\tif consumed := len(args) - len(rest); consumed > 0 && args[consumed-1] == \"--\" {\n\t\t\treturn append(positional, rest...), nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(rest) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn positional, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tpositional = append(positional, rest[0])\n\t\targs = rest[1:]\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":8,"newStart":33,"newLines":8,"lines":[" }"," "," // Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AtNUva2t2YhF8BbTLnyC9w","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/cli/cli.go has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"2dbfdbd9-0dd0-48b9-8906-bd7a55753b6c","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:43:55.601Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/cli/cli.go","oldString":"\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"time\"","newString":"\t\"io\"\n\t\"time\"","originalFile":"// Package cli parses ddkstat arguments and orchestrates a single run.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\nconst usage = \"usage: ddkstat <summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures> <log> [--target NAME] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]\"\n\n// Exit codes, as declared in the architecture.\nconst (\n\texitRead  = 1\n\texitUsage = 2\n)\n\n// reportNames lists the six reports in the order the architecture declares them.\nvar reportNames = []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"}\n\n// Options is the parsed ddkstat command line.\ntype Options struct {\n\tReport    string\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD or empty\n\tLog       string\n}\n\n// Parse reads the command line (program name excluded) into Options. The report comes first,\n// the three options may follow in any order, and exactly one log path comes last. A given\n// --since or --until must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date, or Parse returns an error.\nfunc Parse(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"ddkstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\ttarget := fs.String(\"target\", \"\", \"\")\n\tsince := fs.String(\"since\", \"\", \"\")\n\tuntil := fs.String(\"until\", \"\", \"\")\n\tpositional, err := parseInterspersed(fs, args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\tif len(positional) != 2 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"want one report and one log path, got %d positional arguments\", len(positional))\n\t}\n\tif !isReport(positional[0]) {\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unknown report %q\", positional[0])\n\t}\n\tset := make(map[string]bool)\n\tfs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {\n\t\tset[f.Name] = true\n\t})\n\topts := Options{\n\t\tReport:    positional[0],\n\t\tTarget:    *target,\n\t\tHasTarget: set[\"target\"],\n\t\tLog:       positional[1],\n\t}\n\tif set[\"since\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Since, err = validateDate(*since); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--since: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif set[\"until\"] {\n\t\tif opts.Until, err = validateDate(*until); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"--until: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn opts, nil\n}\n\n// dateLayout is the only accepted form of --since and --until: a real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// validateDate returns value unchanged when it is exactly ten characters and a real calendar\n// date in the YYYY-MM-DD layout, so leap days are honored. It never normalizes a value.\nfunc validateDate(value string) (string, error) {\n\tif len(value) != len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a YYYY-MM-DD date\", value)\n\t}\n\tif _, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a real calendar date\", value)\n\t}\n\treturn value, nil\n}\n\n// isReport reports whether name is one of the six report names.\nfunc isReport(name string) bool {\n\tfor _, r := range reportNames {\n\t\tif r == name {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Run executes ddkstat with args (the program name excluded) and returns the process exit code.\n// Usage errors write the usage line to stderr and return 2; nothing reaches stdout.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := Parse(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(stderr, usage)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\treturn execute(opts, stdout, stderr, func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error) {\n\t\treturn logread.ReadFile(opts.Log, warn)\n\t})\n}\n\n// execute reads the log through load and returns the exit code. A log that cannot be read exits\n// 1 with one diagnostic on stderr. Report output will go to stdout only after the whole log has\n// been read, so a failing read never leaves partial output.\nfunc execute(opts Options, stdout, stderr io.Writer, load func(warn io.Writer) (logread.Result, error)) int {\n\tif _, err := load(stderr); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: cannot read log: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitRead\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"ddkstat: report %q is not implemented yet\\n\", opts.Report)\n\treturn exitRead\n}\n\n// parseInterspersed parses flags that may appear before, between, or after positional\n// arguments, as the flag package alone stops at the first positional. A bare \"--\" ends\n// option parsing, and everything after it is positional.\nfunc parseInterspersed(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) ([]string, error) {\n\tvar positional []string\n\tfor {\n\t\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\trest := fs.Args()\n\t\tif consumed := len(args) - len(rest); consumed > 0 && args[consumed-1] == \"--\" {\n\t\t\treturn append(positional, rest...), nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(rest) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn positional, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tpositional = append(positional, rest[0])\n\t\targs = rest[1:]\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":6,"lines":["   \"flag\"","   \"fmt\"","   \"io\"","-  \"os\"","   \"time\""," ","   \"ddkstat/internal/logread\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01AtNUva2t2YhF8BbTLnyC9w","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

A line that breaks a skip rule, or that\n// repeats an earlier kept execution_id, is counted in Skipped and reported on warn with its\n// 1-based line number. Blank lines are neither records nor skipped. Only a read failure is an error.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tlineNo := 0\n\tfor {\n\t\t// ReadBytes has no line length limit, unlike bufio.Scanner.\n\t\tline, readErr := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif len(line) > 0 {\n\t\t\tlineNo++\n\t\t\tif text := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(text) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\trec, decodeErr := decodeRecord(text)\n\t\t\t\tswitch {\n\t\t\t\tcase decodeErr != nil:\n\t\t\t\t\tres.skip(warn, lineNo, decodeErr)\n\t\t\t\tcase seen[rec.ExecutionID]:\n\t\t\t\t\tres.skip(warn, lineNo, fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate execution_id %q\", rec.ExecutionID))\n\t\t\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif readErr == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif readErr != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{}, readErr\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ReadFile opens path read-only, reads it with Read, and closes it. It returns an error when the\n// path cannot be opened or read, including when it names a directory.\nfunc ReadFile(path string, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tf, err := os.Open(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Result{}, err\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\tinfo, err := f.Stat()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Result{}, err\n\t}\n\tif info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn Result{}, fmt.Errorf(\"%s is a directory\", path)\n\t}\n\treturn Read(f, warn)\n}\n\n// skip counts one skipped line and writes its single warning.\nfunc (res *Result) skip(warn io.Writer, lineNo int, reason error) {\n\tres.Skipped++\n\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"ddkstat: line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, reason)\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2759,"cache_read_input_tokens":73447,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2759},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"e22fab37-af5e-47e2-8386-31184317362d","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:43:58.576Z","request_id":"req_011CgQ12PU54KnDwWNzFoTDW","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01LCNZsFD3xS3mvz8PFLGHaX":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/read.go","content":"package logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n)\n\n// Result is the outcome of reading one log.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record // kept records in file order\n\tSkipped int      // skipped lines in the whole file\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one Record. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgQ12PihTSRrchP5M2fag","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QATCDoc3pPhiVC7MGzJC6z","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/record.go","content":"package logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"time\"\n\t\"unicode/utf8\"\n)\n\n// dateLayout is the calendar date form every report keys on: the first ten characters of started_at.\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// Record is one kept execution from the log.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID  string\n\tStartedAt    string // RFC 3339 UTC; the first 10 characters are the start date\n\tStatus       string\n\tCommand      string // job.command_name\n\tTarget       string // job.target\n\tProvider     string // job.llm\n\tModel        string // result.stats.model when non-empty, otherwise job.model\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n\tReturnCode   *int // nil when null or absent\n\tTimedOut     bool\n}\n\n// Date returns the start date, the first ten characters of StartedAt.\nfunc (r Record) Date() string {\n\tif len(r.StartedAt) < len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn r.StartedAt[:len(dateLayout)]\n}\n\n// Failed reports whether the execution did not succeed.\nfunc (r Record) Failed() bool {\n\treturn r.Status != \"succeeded\"\n}\n\n// decodeRecord decodes one trimmed, non-blank line into a Record. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a87ae7e1-dbec-45af-97d2-33e4ffbf71ef","uuid":"9d7196c3-d999-479a-acd9-d0ed05bce598","timestamp":"2026-10-26T01:44:07.659Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.011913/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/record.go","oldString":"import (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"time\"\n\t\"unicode/utf8\"\n)","newString":"import (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math\"\n\t\"time\"\n\t\"unicode/utf8\"\n)","originalFile":"package logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"time\"\n\t\"unicode/utf8\"\n)\n\n// dateLayout is the calendar date form every report keys on: the first ten characters of started_at.\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// Record is one kept execution from the log.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID  string\n\tStartedAt    string // RFC 3339 UTC; the first 10 characters are the start date\n\tStatus       string\n\tCommand      string // job.command_name\n\tTarget       string // job.target\n\tProvider     string // job.llm\n\tModel        string // result.stats.model when non-empty, otherwise job.model\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n\tReturnCode   *int // nil when null or absent\n\tTimedOut     bool\n}\n\n// Date returns the start date, the first ten characters of StartedAt.\nfunc (r Record) Date() string {\n\tif len(r.StartedAt) < len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn r.StartedAt[:len(dateLayout)]\n}\n\n// Failed reports whether the execution did not succeed.\nfunc (r Record) Failed() bool {\n\treturn r.Status != \"succeeded\"\n}\n\n// decodeRecord decodes one trimmed, non-blank line into a Record. When the line breaks a skip\n// rule it returns an error naming that rule.\nfunc decodeRecord(line []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif !utf8.Valid(line) {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not valid UTF-8\")\n\t}\n\ttop, ok := object(line)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tid, err := requiredString(top, \"execution_id\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\tstartedAt, err := requiredString(top, \"started_at\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\tstatus, err := requiredString(top, \"status\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\tjob, _ := object(top[\"job\"])\n\tcommand, err := requiredString(job, \"command_name\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\ttarget, err := requiredString(job, \"target\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\tif !startsWithDate(startedAt) {\n\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"started_at %q does not begin with a YYYY-MM-DD date\", startedAt)\n\t}\n\n\tresult, _ := object(top[\"result\"])\n\tstats, _ := object(result[\"stats\"])\n\n\tmodel := optionalString(stats, \"model\")\n\tif model == \"\" {\n\t\tmodel = optionalString(job, \"model\")\n\t}\n\trec := Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:  id,\n\t\tStartedAt:    startedAt,\n\t\tStatus:       status,\n\t\tCommand:      command,\n\t\tTarget:       target,\n\t\tProvider:     optionalString(job, \"llm\"),\n\t\tModel:        model,\n\t\tInputTokens:  intField(stats, \"input_tokens\"),\n\t\tCachedTokens: intField(stats, \"cached_input_tokens\"),\n\t\tOutputTokens: intField(stats, \"output_tokens\"),\n\t\tCostUSD:      floatField(stats, \"cost_usd\"),\n\t\tElapsedMS:    intField(stats, \"elapsed_ms\"),\n\t\tTimedOut:     boolField(result, \"timed_out\"),\n\t}\n\tif code, ok := intValue(result[\"returncode\"]); ok {\n\t\tc := int(code)\n\t\trec.ReturnCode = &c\n\t}\n\treturn rec, nil\n}\n\n// startsWithDate reports whether s begins with a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD.\nfunc startsWithDate(s string) bool {\n\tif len(s) < len(dateLayout) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\t_, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, s[:len(dateLayout)])\n\treturn err == nil\n}\n\n// object decodes raw as a JSON object. It reports false when raw is absent, null, or not an object.\nfunc object(raw []byte) (map[string]json.RawMessage, bool) {\n\tvar m map[string]json.RawMessage\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil || m == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n\treturn m, true\n}\n\n// requiredString returns the string at key. It fails when the value is absent, null, not a\n// string, or empty.\nfunc requiredString(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (string, error) {\n\tvar s string\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(obj[key], &s); err != nil || s == \"\" {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%s is not a non-empty string\", key)\n\t}\n\treturn s, nil\n}\n\n// optionalString returns the string at key, or \"\" when the value is absent or not a string.\nfunc optionalString(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) string {\n\tvar s string\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(obj[key], &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// isNumberToken reports whether raw is written as a JSON number. A string that looks like a\n// number is not one, because json.Number would otherwise accept it.\nfunc isNumberToken(raw []byte) bool {\n\traw = bytes.TrimSpace(raw)\n\treturn len(raw) > 0 && (raw[0] == '-' || (raw[0] >= '0' && raw[0] <= '9'))\n}\n\n// intValue decodes raw as a whole JSON number. It reports false for absent, null, wrongly typed,\n// or fractional values.\nfunc intValue(raw []byte) (int64, bool) {\n\tif !isNumberToken(raw) {\n\t\treturn 0, false\n\t}\n\tvar n json.Number\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, false\n\t}\n\tif i, err := n.Int64(); err == nil {\n\t\treturn i, true\n\t}\n\tf, err := n.Float64()\n\tif err != nil || f != math.Trunc(f) || f < math.MinInt64 || f >= math.MaxInt64 {\n\t\treturn 0, false\n\t}\n\treturn int64(f), true\n}\n\n// intField returns the whole number at key, or zero when the value is absent or not a whole number.\nfunc intField(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) int64 {\n\tv, _ := intValue(obj[key])\n\treturn v\n}\n\n// floatField returns the number at key, or zero when the value is absent, null, or not a number.\nfunc floatField(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) float64 {\n\tif !isNumberToken(obj[key]) {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\tvar f float64\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(obj[key], &f); err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn f\n}\n\n// boolField returns the boolean at key, or false when the value is absent or not a boolean.\nfunc boolField(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) bool {\n\tvar b bool\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(obj[key], &b); err != nil {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn b\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":9,"newStart":1,"newLines":11,"lines":[" package logread"," "," import (","+  \"bytes\"","   \"encoding/json\"","   \"errors\"","   \"fmt\"","+  \"math\"","   \"time\"","   \"unicode/utf8\""," )"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_012PzHHpkPMV3v7m4Liv8yNE","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

\"Toml\"\n\tfirst[\"result\"].(map[string]any)[\"stats\"].(map[string]any)[\"input_tokens\"] = 1\n\tsecond := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tsecond[\"job\"].(map[string]any)[\"target\"] = logread\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\n// stats returns the result.stats object of a base record.\nfunc stats(rec map[string]any) map[string]any {\n\treturn rec[\"result\"].(map[string]any)[\"stats\"].(map[string]any)\n}\n\nfunc TestAbsentStatsIsStillRecord(t *testing.T) {\n\trec := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tdelete(rec[\"result\"].(map[string]any), \"stats\")\n\tgot := readOne(t, rec)\n\tif got.InputTokens != 0 || got.CachedTokens != 0 || got.OutputTokens != 0 || got.CostUSD != 0 || got.ElapsedMS != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"numeric fields = %+v, want all zero\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got.ExecutionID != \"a\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ExecutionID = %q, want a\", got.ExecutionID)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNullCostCountsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\trec := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tstats(rec)[\"cost_usd\"] = nil\n\tgot := readOne(t, rec)\n\tif got.CostUSD != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"CostUSD = %v, want 0\", got.CostUSD)\n\t}\n\tif got.InputTokens != 843 || got.OutputTokens != 7751 || got.ElapsedMS != 54872 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"other fields = in %d out %d ms %d, want 843, 7751, 54872\", got.InputTokens, got.OutputTokens, got.ElapsedMS)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestAbsentNumbersCountZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, key := range []string{\"input_tokens\", \"cached_input_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"elapsed_ms\"} {\n\t\tt.Run(key, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\trec := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\t\t\tdelete(stats(rec), key)\n\t\t\tgot := readOne(t, rec)\n\t\t\tswitch key {\n\t\t\tcase \"input_tokens\":\n\t\t\t\tif got.InputTokens != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"InputTokens = %d, want 0\", got.InputTokens)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase \"cached_input_tokens\":\n\t\t\t\tif got.CachedTokens != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"CachedTokens = %d, want 0\", got.CachedTokens)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase \"output_tokens\":\n\t\t\t\tif got.OutputTokens != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"OutputTokens = %d, want 0\", got.OutputTokens)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase \"cost_usd\":\n\t\t\t\tif got.CostUSD != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"CostUSD = %v, want 0\", got.CostUSD)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcase \"elapsed_ms\":\n\t\t\t\tif got.ElapsedMS != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"ElapsedMS = %d, want 0\", got.ElapsedMS)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWrongTypedNumbersCountZero(t *testing.T) {\n\twrong := map[string]any{\n\t\t\"string\":  \"843\",\n\t\t\"boolean\": true,\n\t\t\"array\":   []any{1},\n\t\t\"object\":  map[string]any{\"n\": 1},\n\t}\n\tfor name, value := range wrong {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\trec := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\t\t\tstats(rec)[\"input_tokens\"] = value\n\t\t\tstats(rec)[\"cost_usd\"] = value\n\t\t\tstats(rec)[\"elapsed_ms\"] = value\n\t\t\tres, warn := readText(t, lineOf(t, rec)+\"\\n\")\n\t\t\tif len(res.Records) != 1 || res.Skipped != 0 || warn != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"kept=%d skipped=%d warn=%q, want the record kept\", len(res.Records), res.Skipped, warn)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tgot := res.Records[0]\n\t\t\tif got.InputTokens != 0 || got.CostUSD != 0 || got.ElapsedMS != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"fields = in %d cost %v ms %d, want zeros\", got.InputTokens, got.CostUSD, got.ElapsedMS)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWholeFloatTokensAccepted(t *testing.T) {\n\trec := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tstats(rec)[\"output_tokens\"] = 12.0\n\tstats(rec)[\"input_tokens\"] = 12.5\n\tgot := readOne(t, rec)\n\tif got.OutputTokens != 12 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"OutputTokens = %d, want 12\", got.OutputTokens)\n\t}\n\tif got.InputTokens != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"InputTokens = %d, want 0 for a fractional count\", got.InputTokens)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReturncodeNullOrAbsentIsAbsent(t *testing.T) {\n\tresult := func(rec map[string]any) map[string]any { return rec[\"result\"].(map[string]any) }\n\n\tnullCode := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tresult(nullCode)[\"returncode\"] = nil\n\tif got := readOne(t, nullCode); got.ReturnCode != nil {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"null returncode: ReturnCode = %d, want nil\", *got.ReturnCode)\n\t}\n\n\tabsentCode := baseRecord(\"b\")\n\tdelete(result(absentCode), \"returncode\")\n\tif got := readOne(t, absentCode); got.ReturnCode != nil {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"absent returncode: ReturnCode = %d, want nil\", *got.ReturnCode)\n\t}\n\n\tzeroCode := baseRecord(\"c\")\n\tresult(zeroCode)[\"returncode\"] = 0\n\tif got := readOne(t, zeroCode); got.ReturnCode == nil || *got.ReturnCode != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"returncode 0: ReturnCode = %v, want 0\", got.ReturnCode)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTimedOutDefaultsFalse(t *testing.T) {\n\tabsent := baseRecord(\"a\")\n\tdelete(absent[\"result\"].(map[string]any), \"timed_out\")\n\tif got := readOne(t, absent); got.TimedOut {\n\t\tt.Error(\"absent timed_out: TimedOut = true, want false\")\n\t}\n\n\tnotBool := baseRecord(\"b\")\n\tnotBool[\"result\"].(map[string]any)[\"timed_out\"] = \"yes\"\n\tif got := readOne(t, notBool); got.TimedOut {\n\t\tt.Error(\"string timed_out: TimedOut = true, want false\")\n\t}\n\n\tset := baseRecord(\"c\")\n\tset[\"result\"].(map[string]any)[\"timed_out\"] = true\n\tif got := readOne(t, set); !got.TimedOut {\n\t\tt.Error(\"timed_out true: TimedOut = false, want
